topic: Large Language Models and Prompt Engineering
learningObjectives: Understand the basic components of a large language model workflow
Improve prompts using context, constraints, and examples

activities.title: LLM Workflow Map
activities.instruction: Explore how a prompt becomes an AI-generated response.

content.concept: An LLM processes input tokens using learned parameters and generates output tokens sequentially.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The instruction or input provided by the user.
Converts the input text into tokens that the model can process.
The language model that processes the input and predicts output tokens.
Learned numerical values that influence how the model processes information.
Tokens generated sequentially based on the input and model behavior.
The generated text presented to the user.

activities.title: Prompt Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each prompt component to identify its purpose.

content.concept: Effective prompts can include a task, context, constraints, examples, and an expected output format.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Clearly states what the model needs to do.
Provides relevant background information for the task.
Defines limits such as length, scope, style, or required conditions.
Provides sample inputs or outputs to demonstrate the expected behavior.
Specifies how the response should be structured or presented.

activities.title: Build a Better Prompt
activities.instruction: Assemble prompt components into a clear instruction.

content.concept: Adding relevant context and explicit requirements can make an instruction clearer and more useful.

activities.instruction: Adjust prompt constraints and observe how the expected response changes.

content.concept: Prompt constraints can guide the format, scope, style, and structure of generated responses.
